title: Roos limit of the canonical finite-projective quotient diagram
statement: Let X be any scheme, d an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and U a pro-etale object. Let L_n be specified left adjoints to levelwise derived scalar restriction. The canonical quotient diagram of a bounded finite-projective A-complex P [lem-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-quotient-diagram], followed by completed constant realization and exact slice restriction, has that completed realization of P as its Roos derived limit [def-weil-derived-limit]. No arbitrary algebraic tower, marking, geometric trivialization or completeness hypothesis on A is supplied.

source.place: Tag 09C6, lemma-connected-adic-lisse: the displayed equality of ordinary and derived limits of the finite-projective quotient complex; Cohomology on Sites, Tags 0940 and 0941.

proof.text: Apply the canonical coefficient-complex comparison to obtain an explicit tower T and cone c with compatible finite-free retracts degree by degree, a whole-diagram localization comparison, and the cone-point realization comparison.

The proved compatible-retract complex calculation makes Q(c.pt) a Roos limit of T localized levelwise. Exact countable products supply the global derived products. Transport the Roos triangle along the diagram and point isomorphisms; one minus shift is conjugated by the product of the component isomorphisms.

Localize the exact slice extension/restriction adjunction to show that derived restriction is a right adjoint. It preserves products, and its exact derived functor is triangulated. Apply it to the global Roos triangle, obtaining the specified local realization and its canonical quotient diagram.

theorem finitePerfectAdicMarked_roos
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (U : X.ProEt)
    [HasCountableProducts
      (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} ((completedAdicRing X d).over U)))]
    (L : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t} A) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{t} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))))
    (adj : ∀ n : ℕ, L n ⊣ DerivedCategory.adicLevelRestriction d.ideal n)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} A) ℤ) (a b : ℤ)
    (ha : P.IsStrictlyGE a) (hb : P.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hP : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Projective A (P.X i) ∧ Module.Finite A (P.X i)) :
    let F := finitePerfectAdicQuotientDiagram d.ideal L adj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ⋙
      finitePerfectAdicLocalRealization X d U
    IsDerivedLimit (K := fun n : ℕ ↦ F.obj (op n))
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ F.map (homOfLE n.le_succ).op)
      ((finitePerfectAdicLocalRealization X d U).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
